description: This PHP source file generates a web page for configuring RIP routing protocol settings on a router. It includes HTML, JavaScript, and PHP code to display, populate, and handle form inputs for RIP configuration, as well as some PHP includes for headers and utilities.

methods.name: initPopulate
methods.description: Populates form fields with data from the PHP variable jsRIPEntry.

methods.name: initEventHandler
methods.description: Sets event handlers for the authentication type selection to enable or disable input fields.

methods.name: saveRIP
methods.description: Sends the RIP configuration data via AJAX to the server and handles success or failure responses.
